objective: Establish and enforce a selective Git versioning policy for durable model artifacts, tracking workflow authority and valuable durable artifacts while excluding runtime logs by default.

in: tracking completed SWE workflow authority for the relevant initiative
out: changing artifact path schema or SWE lifecycle semantics

constraints: workflow.json remains exclusively mutated by pi-swe
runtime logs stay local by default
specs, plans, findings, and reports remain selectively reviewed rather than blanket-staged
generated workflow authority may be committed when intentionally selected

acceptanceCriteria.text: Repository documentation defines an explicit selective versioning matrix for workflow authority and every model-artifact kind.
Initiative and system runtime log directories are ignored by Git without ignoring workflow.json or selectively valuable artifacts.
Automated tests protect the documented tracking policy and ignore rules.
The completed swe-lifecycle-autonomy workflow authority is included in the implementation commit while its revision logs and unrelated initiative artifacts are excluded.

assessment.reason: This is a bounded repository policy and documentation change with a small Git-ignore and regression-test surface.

practices.practice: Explicit repository policy with regression coverage
practices.reason: Selective tracking must remain understandable and resist accidental drift.

obligations.text: Verify documentation and ignore-policy tests pass and inspect the final staged scope for only intended authority and source files.

work.title: Document and enforce selective model-artifact versioning

testing.approach: Add focused assertions for the documented matrix and Git ignore patterns, then run typecheck and repository tests.
testing.reason: The behavior is policy-driven and should fail visibly if documentation or ignore rules regress.

args: npm run typecheck && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/contributor-docs.test.ts && npm run check:model-artifacts

evidence.summary: Model self-review found no blocking issues. The documented matrix covers workflow authority and every artifact kind; ignore rules target only canonical initiative and system logs; focused tests prove workflows, specs, plans, findings, and reports remain visible; the staged scope contains only the three policy/test files and completed swe-lifecycle-autonomy authority. Runtime logs and unrelated pi-todo-delete authority are excluded.

decisions.text: Track workflow.json by default for substantial or shared initiatives, including final completed authority.
decisions.basis: Repository durability across clones, branches, sessions, and reviewers outweighs manageable branch-local merge churn.

decisions.text: Ignore runtime logs by default and review other generated Markdown artifacts individually.
decisions.basis: Logs are high-volume operational noise while specs, plans, findings, and reports have variable durable value.

risks.text: Broad ignore patterns could hide valuable reports or workflow authority.
risks.mitigation: Ignore only directories named logs beneath canonical initiative and system scopes, with tests proving workflow and other kinds remain visible.
